race.description: Bill & Lurl Perry Memorial Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: THIS AIN'T TEXAS (11) was much better on a firmer surface at Moruya nearly 3 weeks ago when finishing fourth. She hails from the powerful Matt Dale stable, who usually come here with big winning chances. She dons the blinkers, and is the one to beat for us. THE ULTIMATE STAR (4) is backing up quickly from a strong finishing fifth at Wagga 6-days ago, and with a big swing in his draw this time, he can figure in the top 3. FOLSOMPRISONHOOVES (12) has been narrowly beaten in her last 2 starts, and will still be on the up with her fitness. She would only needs an ounce of luck from a wide gate, to be right in the finish again. SENSESATIONAL STAR (8) has been trying to win a race for some time, and was solid enough 6-days ago at Wagga when whacking away for fourth, just in front of the second pick in the same race. Include in all top 4 combos to be safe. FIGHTING FOX (5) will be peaking third up from a spell, and stepping out to 1400m for the first time should help her. Keep safe.
